statuses.installable-plugin: Copy/install as-is; configured in the host's admin UI.

contract.paidSessions: 202 {status:'payment_required', order:{checkoutUrl,...}} handled by the SDK (checkout.stripe.com only)

verification.method: sdk/kits/test/fresh-install.sh: fresh vendor scaffolds in a scratch directory, the real Django backend (DEBUG, Postgres 16) seeded with seed_public_demo --allow-registration, a proxy-scoped key, and Chromium driven by Playwright 1.58.2 (sdk/kits/test/fresh-install/flow.cjs). productionTested stays false: http on localhost, no TLS, no CDN, no paid session.
verification.browserFlow: profile 200 + __Host-webinar_csrf set and stored; anonymous full form; consent default denied (payload consents false, no attribution despite ?utm_source); registration 201 with CSRF header; thank-you + calendar link on this origin; ICS 200 text/calendar; webinar_session re-issued HttpOnly; reload hides recognised fields and shows 'Confirm my RSVP' (fully covered form); confirm-only resubmit with empty profile; 'Not you? Start over' resets and clears the session cookie; WebinarForm.setConsent({analytics:true}) grants consent and captures utm_source; unknown route 404, wrong method 405, bad query 400; no page errors.
notVerified: https hosts other than localhost (the __Host- cookie needs a secure context)

verified.summary: php -l clean on all six PHP files; wp-cli install, plugin activation, pretty permalinks; block page and [webinar_form] shortcode page each pass the 30-check browser flow; Settings page (manage_options, key reported as set from WEBINAR_PLATFORM_PROXY_KEY and never echoed, backend URL with a path rejected and previous value kept, options.php save persists, plugin options absent from /wp-json/wp/v2/settings); block registered in the editor; WP Super Cache caches pages but leaves /webinar-api/* uncached with fresh CSRF tokens; subdirectory install at /blog/ (proxyBase /blog/webinar-api, root-level /webinar-api 404) passes the flow.
fixed: rewrite_set_cookie dropped Django's webinar_session="" expiry on reset, so the revoked capability cookie lingered
a self-hosted SDK path was emitted as /blog/blog/... on subdirectory installs (now resolved via home_url)
notVerified: https (the __Host- cookie only worked over http because Chromium treats localhost as a secure context)

verified.summary: mount.cjs in-process with Next 16 and SvelteKit 3 (approach A); nginx-webinar-api.conf included verbatim passes nginx -t and, with the sidecar on the Docker host, fronts Astro, Nuxt and a static page (approach B) through the full browser flow.
fixed: the catch-all `location ^~ /webinar-api/ { return 404; }` took precedence over the regex route block, so every proxy route returned 404 from nginx
sdk/proxy/server.js rewriteSetCookie now accepts RFC 6265 DQUOTE-wrapped values (Django's delete_cookie)
notVerified: PROXY_TRUST_FORWARDED_FOR with a real client IP chain
